cards.title: The Protégé Problem
cards.instruction: Treat another player as someone you trained. Offer corrections, backhanded praise, and reminders of your influence.

cards.title: Put It Back Quietly
cards.instruction: Return something you misplaced, used, or damaged without revealing why it needed restoring.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Your plate's back in the cupboard. I taught you to set a welcoming table; those flowers will help on Sunday.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Our plates were plain. Where did that one come from?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Good, your eye for a pattern is improving. I'll use the flowered one and cover it with potatoes.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: No. I want six matching plates, not you hiding one.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: You're finally thinking about the whole table. I'll get five more flowered ones. Leave the plain ones in the cupboard; we'll use my new arrangement on Sunday.

reason: Use the pupil supposed design development to justify a replacement plate and then an entire matched set, while avoiding the question about the original.
